item.content:encoded:
I hate Sarkic lore. This was pretty entertaining to read as a parody of that. I appreciated it for that and enjoyed the piece.

Two side notes, one for the author and one in general.

First — that's not a rough translation. That translation is pretty straightforward and literal.

Second — given that immortals don't actually exist, I think it's pretty unrealistic of people who constantly try to take umbrage with how they speak. There's a constant demand that their speech patterns never change remotely, even when they are acting like a regular person. If you don't adapt to life in the modern world — and more than anything else, that includes your vernacular and slang — then you'll stick out like a sore thumb in what, fifty years?

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
The interview log is a bit rough, but I think this hits all the right notes. It's a solid attempt at a parody of Sarkic lore. Though I will say, I have only a passing knowledge of Sarkicism on the Wiki — I've read a few of its articles and know some names, and that's it. So maybe, if I knew less about the subject matter (to the point of not picking up on anything), or more (to the point of being considered a fan of Sarkicism, which I admit I am not), this wouldn't work. But at my current knowledge level it really, really does.

It's late and I have a headache but I hope this makes sense. This is a unique one for me.

I can see some careless mistakes here or there, most obviously XXXXs all over the place. But honestly I think this was a funny article. It doesn't outlive its welcome, it doesn't do a lore dump. And ultimately this is well written, especially the dialogue upon which the entire article centers.

I hope this survives, I think its a welcome funny addition to the Sarkic lore (as a devotee to Sarkicism, I actually think a little bit of a lighter toned story is well overdue)… not to mention the idea of one of the object of a cult's worship not having the time or inclination to deal with the modern day cult is very appealing to me. Religion is mostly ridiculous, and holy stories are corrupted over time.

Not to mention the ending lines of this article are straight fire. I think its great, if could use a little cleaning up.

+1
